info.name: Delta Homes API
info.description:
Backend REST API for the Delta Homes marketplace (Spring Boot + PostgreSQL).

Base URL is controlled by the collection variable `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:8080).

## Unified response envelope

EVERY endpoint returns the same structure.

Success — single resource or acknowledgement:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { ... }, "message": null }
```

Success — lists (pagination metadata attached):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [ ... ],
  "pagination": { "page": 0, "size": 20, "totalElements": 42, "totalPages": 3, "hasNext": true }
}
```

Error (one shape for all failures):
```json
{ "success": false, "status": 400, "error": "Human-readable message", "fields": {"field": "problem"}, "timestamp": "..." }
```
(`fields` appears only on validation errors; DELETE endpoints return 204 with no body.)

The `token` and `refreshToken` collection variables are set automatically after a successful **Login**, **Login with Email**, **Login with OTP** or **Login with Email OTP** request, so authenticated requests can use `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`. Role-specific variables (`customerToken`, `ownerToken`, `companyToken`, `adminToken`) support the role-matrix flows in TESTING_GUIDE.md.

## OTP & registration (SMTP-first)

OTP delivery is **SMTP (email) first**:
- `POST /auth/otp/send-email` sends a code to an email address (used by new users).
- `POST /auth/otp/send` (phone) only works for **already-registered** users (SMS). Unknown phones are rejected with a message directing to the email flow.

To register a new account (recommended flow):
1. `POST /auth/otp/send-email` with purpose REGISTRATION
2. Read the OTP from the server console (dev mode) or the inbox.
3. `POST /auth/register-email` with the code in `otpCode`.

## Locale (Arabic-first)

Every request sends Accept-Language: {{lang}} (collection variable, default **ar**). Change it to en (or use ?lang= on any URL) to switch error messages and localized content to English.

Seeded demo accounts (password `secret123`) exist for every role — see TESTING_GUIDE.md. Admin: phone 01026962089 / password admin123 / permanent OTP from config.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit SMS OTP. `purpose` is one of REGISTRATION | LOGIN | PASSWORD_RESET.\nSMS is only sent to **existing** users (phone already registered). Unknown phones are rejected - new users must use Send Email OTP. In dev mode (no SMTP/Twilio credentials) codes are printed to the server console.
Verifies a phone OTP without creating an account. Optional - the register/login endpoints verify the code themselves.

Sends a 6-digit OTP to an email address via SMTP - the primary channel for **new** users. `purpose` is one of REGISTRATION | LOGIN | PASSWORD_RESET. When no SMTP host is configured (dev mode) the code is logged to the server console.
Verifies an email OTP without creating an account. Optional - the register-email/login endpoints verify the code themselves.

Phone-based registration. Note: with the SMTP-first OTP policy, phone OTP is only sent to **existing** users, so new accounts should be created via Register with Email. `role` is one of CUSTOMER | OWNER | OFFICE | COMPANY | TECHNICIAN (ADMIN is provisioned by the platform).

Registers a new account with an email. Requires a verified REGISTRATION OTP sent via Send Email OTP (SMTP). `role` is one of CUSTOMER | OWNER | OFFICE | COMPANY | TECHNICIAN (ADMIN is provisioned by the platform). Returns access + refresh tokens.
Logs in with phone + password. Stores the returned tokens in the `token` and `refreshToken` collection variables for subsequent requests.
Logs in with email + password. Stores the returned tokens in the collection variables for subsequent requests.
Password-less login using a LOGIN-purpose phone OTP. The account must already exist (SMS is only sent to existing users). Stores tokens into collection variables.
Password-less login using a LOGIN-purpose email OTP (SMTP). Stores tokens into collection variables.

Exchanges a valid refresh token for a fresh pair of access + refresh tokens. Rotation: each call issues a NEW refresh token and invalidates the old jti - reusing an already-rotated token is rejected as theft. The new pair is stored into the collection variables.
Negative test: paste a PREVIOUSLY-ROTATED refresh token here. Expected: 400 'Invalid or expired refresh token' because its jti no longer matches the one stored for the user.
Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user (requires a valid access token).
Changes the password of the authenticated user. Requires the current password.
Resets a forgotten password. Requires a PASSWORD_RESET OTP sent to the account phone (existing users only). No authentication needed.
Resets a forgotten password using a PASSWORD_RESET email OTP (SMTP). No authentication needed.

Logs out the authenticated user. Server-side: revokes the stored refresh-token jti so the current refresh token can no longer be exchanged (access token stays valid until it expires - 1h). Test script verifies a subsequent /refresh fails.
Paginated list of cities with optional full-text search on the city name (Arabic and English). Returns CitySummary projections. Public.
Paginated list of districts. Optional `q` full-text search and optional `cityId` filter. Returns DistrictSummary projections. Public.
Paginated list of services (finishing / maintenance categories). Optional `q` full-text search and optional `category` filter. Returns ServiceSummary projections. Public.
Paginated list of property features with optional `q` full-text search. Returns FeatureSummary projections. Public.
Paginated list of subscription plans. Optional `q` search, `tier` (BASIC | PREMIUM | ENTERPRISE) and `isActive` filters. Returns SubscriptionPlanSummary projections. Public.

Paginated property index with PostgreSQL full-text search (`q`) and filters: `cityId`, `districtId`, `purpose` (SALE | RENT), `minPrice`, `maxPrice`. Supports `sort` (e.g. `price,desc`, `createdAt,asc`) and paging. Only PUBLISHED properties are returned. Response is the standard PaginatedResponse envelope with PropertySummary items.

Returns full details of a single property by UUID as a PropertyDetailResponse DTO (owner is reduced to id+name; no password hash or raw entity leakage). Public. Test script stores the id into `propertyId`.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Apartment in Toriel",
  "description": "3 bedroom apartment, fully finished",
  "price": 750000,
  "purpose": "SALE",
  "category": "APARTMENT",
  "cityId": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
  "districtId": "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222",
  "street": "Toriel Main Street",
  "readiness": "READY",
  "finishingLevel": "FINISHED"
}

request.description: Creates a property listing (returns 201). Requires authentication - the `owner` is taken from the token. Server-controlled fields (`status` forced to DRAFT, `isFeatured` false) can NOT be set by clients - mass assignment is rejected/ignored. Required fields: title, price, purpose (SALE|RENT), category, cityId, districtId, readiness (READY|UNDER_CONSTRUCTION). Optional: description, street, latitude, longitude, finishingLevel (UNFINISHED|SEMI_FINISHED|FINISHED|LUXURY), features. Test script stores the created id into `propertyId`.

Partially updates a property owned by the authenticated user (all fields optional; only non-null fields are applied). Ownership enforced: another user's property returns 403, an unknown id 404, archived properties are rejected. ADMIN may update any property.
Negative test: a user who does not own the property must receive 403 Forbidden.
Deletes a property owned by the authenticated user (returns 204). Ownership enforced as with update. Run this LAST in a property flow since it removes the fixture.

Paginated company index with full-text search (`q`) and optional `type` filter (REAL_ESTATE_OFFICE | FINISHING_COMPANY | MAINTENANCE_PROVIDER). Supports `sort` and paging. Only VERIFIED companies are returned. Returns CompanySummary projections. Public.
Returns a company profile by UUID (raw entity; lazy relations serialize as id-only). Public.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Toriel Finishing Co.",
  "type": "FINISHING_COMPANY",
  "description": "Interior design and full finishing packages",
  "logoUrl": "https://example.com/logo.png",
  "coverUrl": "https://example.com/cover.png",
  "phone": "01012345678",
  "whatsapp": "01012345678",
  "email": "contact@torielfinishing.com",
  "website": "https://torielfinishing.com",
  "coverageArea": "[\"Damietta\", \"New Damietta\"]"
}

request.description: Creates a company profile (returns 201). Requires authentication - `owner` is taken from the token; `verified`, `followersCount`, `reputationScore` and `plan` are server-controlled defaults. `type` is REAL_ESTATE_OFFICE | FINISHING_COMPANY | MAINTENANCE_PROVIDER. `coverageArea` is a JSONB string.
Follows a company to receive its broadcasts. Requires authentication. Returns a FollowResponse: `{"companyId": ..., "companyName": ..., "following": true}`.
Unfollows a company. Requires authentication. Returns 200.
Returns the list of companies followed by the authenticated user (CompanySummaryResponse array). Requires authentication.
Checks whether the authenticated user follows the company. Returns `{"following": true|false}`. Requires authentication.

Paginated review index. Optional `q` full-text search on the review comment, `entityType` (PROPERTY | COMPANY | TECHNICIAN | SERVICE_PROVIDER), `entityId` and `minRating` (1-5) filters. Supports `sort` (e.g. `rating,desc`). Returns ReviewSummary projections. Public.

Returns rating aggregates for an entity: `{"ratingCount": 5, "averageRating": 4.2, "distribution": {"1":0,"2":0,"3":1,"4":2,"5":2}}`. `entityType` is PROPERTY | COMPANY | TECHNICIAN | SERVICE_PROVIDER. Public.

Creates a review (returns 201). Requires authentication. Rules: one review per user per entity; rating 1-5; if `sourceAppointmentId` is provided it must belong to the reviewer and be ACCEPTED/COMPLETED (interaction gate) for `interactionVerified=true`.

Paginated list of the authenticated user's appointments, both as customer and as owner/company. Optional `status` filter (PENDING | ACCEPTED | REJECTED | COMPLETED | CANCELLED). Returns AppointmentSummary projections. Requires authentication.

Books a property viewing (returns 201). Requires authentication - `customer` is taken from the token and `owner` is derived from the property. `requestedSlot` is an ISO-8601 OffsetDateTime and must be in the future. Status starts as PENDING.

Updates an appointment status. Allowed transitions: PENDING -> ACCEPTED | REJECTED | CANCELLED; ACCEPTED -> COMPLETED | CANCELLED. Only the customer, the property owner or an admin may change the status. Requires authentication.
Legacy status update (same rules as the PUT /status endpoint). Prefer `PUT /api/v1/appointments/{id}/status`.

Paginated list of the authenticated user's conversations, newest first. Each entry includes the other participant's id/name and the last message preview. The legacy path `/api/v1/conversations` also works. Requires authentication.

Creates (or returns the existing) 1:1 conversation between the authenticated user and the given participant. Conversations are currently 1:1 - provide exactly one participant id, not yourself. Pair ordering is normalized, so creating from either side yields the SAME row (race-safe via DB unique constraint). Returns a ConversationResponse DTO where `otherUser` is resolved relative to the caller. Test script stores it into `conversationId`.
Returns a single conversation (participants + preview + last-seen markers). Only accessible to the participants. Requires authentication.
Paginated list of messages in a conversation, with optional `q` full-text search on the message text. Participants only (403 otherwise). Returns MessageSummary projections. Requires authentication.

Sends a message in a conversation (returns 201). Body: `content` (text), optional `type` (TEXT | IMAGE | LOCATION | VOICE | PDF | PROPERTY_CARD | APPOINTMENT_CARD; defaults to TEXT), `mediaUrl` and `payload` (JSON string). Content or media is required. Participants only. Updates the conversation preview.
Marks the conversation as read by the authenticated participant (updates the last-seen marker). Returns `{"message": "Conversation marked as read"}`. Participants only.
Universal search across properties, companies and services. NOTE: currently a stub - returns `{"query": q, "results": "Meilisearch integration pending"}`. Public.
Paginated list of the authenticated user's saved items. `entityType` is REQUIRED (PROPERTY | COMPANY | TECHNICIAN | SERVICE_PROVIDER). Returns SavedItemResponse items. Requires authentication.
Saves an item (property / company / provider) for the authenticated user (returns 201). `entityType` is PROPERTY | COMPANY | TECHNICIAN | SERVICE_PROVIDER. Requires authentication.
Removes a saved item by entity type + entity id (returns 204). Requires authentication.
Spec-compliant delete by saved-item UUID (returns 204). Ownership is enforced - you can only delete your own saved items. Requires authentication.

Paginated broadcast index with full-text search (`q`) and optional `companyId` / `type` filters. `type` is NEW_PROPERTY | OFFER | DISCOUNT | VIDEO | NEWS. Returns BroadcastSummary projections. Requires authentication.
Creates a broadcast to followers. NOTE: currently a stub - the payload is echoed back without being persisted. Requires authentication (company user).

Paginated user index. Optional `q` full-text search (name / phone / email), `role` (CUSTOMER | OWNER | OFFICE | COMPANY | TECHNICIAN | ADMIN) and `status` (ACTIVE | SUSPENDED | PENDING | DELETED) filters. Safe summaries only. Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated moderation report index. Optional `q` search, `status` (OPEN | REVIEWING | RESOLVED | DISMISSED) and `entityType` filters. Requires ADMIN role.

Paginated document/identity verification index. Optional `status` (PENDING | ACCEPTED | REJECTED) and `type` (PHONE | EMAIL | NATIONAL_ID | COMMERCIAL_REGISTRY) filters. Requires ADMIN role. Test script stores the first result's id into `verificationId` for the Decide Verification request.
Paginated fraud flag index. Optional `flagType` (DUPLICATE_LISTING | FAKE_REVIEW | SPAM_MESSAGE | ABNORMAL_FOLLOW_ACTIVITY) and `status` filters. Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated coupon index with optional `q` full-text search on the coupon code. Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated payment index. Optional `status` filter (PENDING | PAID | FAILED | REFUNDED). Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated audit log index. Optional `q` search (action / reason) and `adminId` filter. Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated subscription index. Optional `status` filter (ACTIVE | EXPIRED | CANCELLED). Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated broadcast index (admin view across all companies). Optional `q` search, `companyId` and `type` filters. Requires ADMIN role.

Applies an admin decision to a PENDING verification and persists it (status, reviewedBy, reviewedAt) plus an audit-log entry. `decision` is APPROVE | REJECT (ACCEPTED/REJECTED also accepted). REJECT requires a non-blank `reason`. Returns the updated VerificationSummary. Already-decided verifications are rejected with 400. Requires ADMIN role. Test script stores the id into `verificationId` on List Verifications first.
